title: Relative tangent bundle
statement:
Let $f:X\to Y$ be a smooth morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme, def-sbc-smooth-morphisms], and put $F=\Omega_{X/Y}$, the sheaf of relative Kähler differentials [def-sc-relative-differential-sheaf]. Its affine-local associated-module description makes $F$ quasi-coherent in the sense of [pqf-def-coherent]. Let $\mathcal A=\operatorname{Sym}_{\mathcal O_X}(F)$ and $j:F\to\mathcal A$ be the symmetric algebra sheaf and generator map constructed in [lem-weil-pbc-symmetric-algebra-sheaf-construction]. Use its quasi-coherence and affine-section identifications from [lem-weil-pbc-quasi-coherent-symmetric-algebra-affine]. The relative tangent bundle is the relative spectrum with its structural projection [lem-weil-pbc-affine-morphism-relative-spec],
$$
\pi:T_{X/Y}:=\underline{\operatorname{Spec}}_X(\mathcal A)\longrightarrow X.
$$
The augmentation $\epsilon:\mathcal A\to\mathcal O_X$ is the unique morphism of $\mathcal O_X$-algebras with $\epsilon\circ j=0$, supplied by [lem-weil-pbc-quasi-coherent-symmetric-algebra-core] for the zero linear map $F\to\mathcal O_X$. Identify $\underline{\operatorname{Spec}}_X(\mathcal O_X)$ with $X$ by [lem-weil-pbc-affine-morphism-relative-spec](2)-(3) applied to $\mathrm{id}_X$. The zero section $z:X\to T_{X/Y}$ is the $X$-morphism corresponding contravariantly to $\epsilon$ under that anti-equivalence. On an affine open $U=\operatorname{Spec}R\subseteq X$, its restriction is the spectrum map [def-weil-affine-spectrum] of the augmentation $\operatorname{Sym}_R(F(U))\to R$ that fixes constants and kills all degree-one generators. In particular $\pi\circ z=\mathrm{id}_X$.

proof.text: The zeroSectionOver morphism has source the identity X-scheme, so its over-category equation is zeroSection followed by projection equal to the identity. Full faithfulness maps its defining preimage back to counit followed by augmentationToBase. Composing with the inverse counit identifies pullback along zeroSection with the augmentation.

The affine symmetric-algebra comparison makes sectionMap on an affine open bijective. The projection is affine by its defining full-subcategory property; hence the inverse image of an affine open is affine, and its toSpecGamma map is an isomorphism. The counit isomorphism on sections and Spec applied to sectionMap are isomorphisms, so their composite affineChart is an isomorphism.

Applying the under-category equation to algebraIso on U identifies the scalar inclusion followed by sectionMap and algebraIso with projection.app U. Naturality of toSpecGamma and the inverse affine-open isomorphism then give the chart projection equation.

Use augmentation_spec for the explicitly constructed augmentation: on sectionwise symmetric algebras it is algebraMapInv. Combining this with the counit pullback equation proves the section-ring identity for the restricted zero section. Naturality of toSpecGamma for appLE, followed by contravariant functoriality of Spec, gives the zero-section chart equation.
